    Run Non-Metric Multidimensional Scaling via vegan::metaMDS

    run_nmds.Rd

    Run Non-Metric Multidimensional Scaling via vegan::metaMDS

    Usage

    run_nmds(
  tb,
  assay = "counts",
  method = "bray",
  k = 2,
  trymax = 50,
  trace = 0,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    tb

    A tidy_microbiome object.

    assay

    Assay name to use. Defaults to "counts".

    method

    Dissimilarity index to pass to vegan::metaMDS. Defaults to "bray".

    k

    Number of dimensions. Defaults to 2.

    trymax

    Maximum number of random starts. Defaults to 50.

    trace

    Numeric trace output (0 for silent). Defaults to 0.

    ...

    Additional arguments passed to vegan::metaMDS.

    Value

    A tibble of ordination coordinates (NMDS1, NMDS2, etc.) joined with sample metadata, with stress stored as an attribute.
